payload.title: The event-contracts adapter reads BaseEvent by its own rules: the unit is any first file ending in /base-event.ts (the owner matches one exact path) and its members are read syntactically in analyzeBaseEvent but through the checker in the new check
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:232-238 (baseEventUnit: first unit whose path ends with /base-event.ts)
tools/gates/event-consumer-index.ts:1419 (the owner's BaseEvent declaration: exactly libs/event-contracts/src/base-event.ts, not exported)
tools/gates/event-consumer-index.ts:1448-1453 (eventDefinitionsIn decides BaseEvent heritage with that exact-path rule)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:422-429 (the new check takes its BaseEvent member set from baseEventUnit and the checker)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:286-291 (analyzeBaseEvent reads BaseEvent members with the syntactic interfaceProperties)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:689-697 (interfaceProperties lists own property signatures only, no inherited member)
payload.rule_violated: CLAUDE.md single-owner discipline (one definition per fact): 'what is BaseEvent' has an owner in tools/gates/event-consumer-index.ts and the adapter keeps a second file rule and a second member reader beside it, with no pin tying them.
payload.notes: If a second file named base-event.ts appears under the scan root and sorts before the real one, baseEventUnit picks it while eventDefinitionsIn still keys heritage on the real file, so the new check sets aside the wrong member names and analyzeBaseEvent reports base_event_field_missing for the wrong interface. If BaseEvent ever gains a heritage clause, interfaceProperties would miss inherited required fields (false HIGH base_event_field_missing) while the new check, reading through the checker, would not. Neither is reachable on main (one base-event.ts at this revision, BaseEvent has no heritage). Close condition: Take BaseEvent from the owner (export its declaration test from event-consumer-index.ts or resolve the symbol through the contract interface's base type) and read its members through the same checker-based reader in both checks; a test with a lookalike a/base-event.ts and one with a BaseEvent heritage clause shows no change in findings. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
